title: test(spec): the deleted-baseline reachability pin measures descent below the unregistered connector root again
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBY61hHdLdFdzwXbxaNtv58y)_
Fixes #29668

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`build-schemas-check-mode.deleted-baseline.test.ts` 的 #17356 用例在原有的根自身 def(`integration/DeclarativeConnectorEntry`)旁，新增一个挂在未注册根 `connector` 之下的 def:`integration/ConnectorInstanceBearerAuth`(`connector.auth` → 实例鉴权联合 → `bearer` 分支)，并加夹具诚实守卫。仅测试,+97/−1。
- 为什么改:#29573 把该用例的样本移到根自身 def 后，实测它已不能判别 #17356 缺陷：根集合收窄回已注册类型时，它经共享的 `_lock` 等记账键实例被读成 derived-clone,删除照样被拒；新样本此时读 `null`,会被 proof 2 豁免，正是该缺陷的形态。
- 风险与回滚：不改任何生成器或 schema,不动任何接受集合；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：测试文件中 `DELETED_BENEATH_UNREGISTERED_KIND_DEF` 的文档注释，再看 `beforeAll` 里 #29668 守卫和 #17356 用例中新增的四条断言。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project repo scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.deleted-baseline.test.ts -t 17356`,预期通过；把 `computeSurfaceReachability()` 的 BFS 改为不下探未注册根，预期本用例在新断言处变红，下方两次消融均已实测。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **Depth specimen.** The #17356 case seeds a third deleted base line, `integration/ConnectorInstanceBearerAuth:zzBeneathAnUnregisteredRoot29668`, and asserts that check (c) refuses it: in the eager regime it reads `def reachable from the metadata-type roots; … was LIVE`, in the lazy regime `def … was LIVE (never tombstoned)`, and in neither does it read `def not reachable from the …` (the proof-2 waiver). The existing specimen and its assertions are unchanged. It runs in the same spawned run as the existing specimen, so no new spawn and no test-budget change.
- **Fixture guard.** `beforeAll` holds the def beneath `connector` and beneath no other root. It reads the def the way the gate does, on both routes: its own instance in a BFS closure (`zodChildSchemas`), and a shape entry (same name, same instance) held by a visited object node (`zodShapeOf`). It also checks the def is still emitted with authorable keys. Imports added for the guard only: `getMetadataTypeSchema`, `ConnectorInstanceBearerAuthSchema`, `zodChildSchemas` and `zodShapeOf`.
- **Docblock.** The constant's docblock says why the root's own def no longer discriminates, gives the measurement, and lists the nine sibling arms that qualify the same way.

## Why

#29573 moved the #17356 specimen from `integration/RetryConfig` to the connector root's own def. The card asks for a specimen beneath that root again. Measuring which one qualifies on `main` turned up more than the card said: the root's own def no longer catches the defect at all.

Every metadata document carries the shared bookkeeping keys (`_lock`, `_lockReason`, …) as the same schema instances. So with the roots narrowed back to `listMetadataTypeSchemaTypes()` (the #17356 defect), `integration/DeclarativeConnectorEntry` resolves as `derived-clone` through any registered root's `_lock`, and check (c) still refuses its deletion. Only the wording changes. The existing pin goes red on that wording, but the waiver it was written against no longer happens to it.

## Measurement (on `main` at 0e4b0fa4)

A one-off probe, deleted before commit, ran the gate's own walk (`zodChildSchemas` closure plus the shape-entry bridge) over every Integration/Shared/… namespace export, in both schema regimes. Defs that read `root-graph` from `connector` and not from the other 32 roots:

| def | without `connector` | on the surface |
|---|---|---|
| `integration/ConnectorInstance{NoAuth,BearerAuth,APIKeyAuth,BasicAuth,OAuth2AuthorizationCodeAuth,OAuth2ClientCredentialsAuth,AppCredentialAuth,SignedAlipayV3Auth,SignedAliyunAcs3Auth,SignedTencentCloudTc3Auth}` | `null` | yes (10) |
| `integration/ConnectorInstance{Auth,OAuth2Auth,SignedAuth}` (unions) | `null` | no keys |
| `integration/DeclarativeConnectorEntry` (the root's own def) | `derived-clone` | yes |

With the registered set alone (30 roots, the pre-#17356 roots): `DeclarativeConnectorEntry` gives `derived-clone`, `ConnectorInstanceBearerAuth` gives `null`, in both regimes. `bearer` was picked as the plainest arm.

## Ablations (the new assertion, red; then restored)

Each ablation edited `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts`, ran `vitest run --project repo … -t 17356` under `os-verify-lock`, and was restored with `git checkout`. The committed tree has no generator change.

1. **Stop the walk at the unregistered roots.** The root stays visited, but the BFS does not push its children. Exit 1, red at the new eager assertion (`:617`). The gate printed:
   - `integration/ConnectorInstanceBearerAuth:zzBeneathAnUnregisteredRoot29668 — def not reachable from the 33 metadata-type roots` (waived)
   - `integration/DeclarativeConnectorEntry:zzOnlyRootIsAnUnregisteredKind17356 — def reachable from the metadata-type roots; … was LIVE (never tombstoned).` (the existing assertions held)

   Only the new specimen measures the descent.
2. **Narrow the roots back to the registered set** (the #17356 defect: drop the `listUnregisteredKindSchemaTypes()` line from `reachabilityRootTypes()`). Exit 1, red at the existing wording assertion (`:606`). The gate printed:
   - `ConnectorInstanceBearerAuth:… — def not reachable from the 30 metadata-type roots` (waived)
   - `DeclarativeConnectorEntry:… — def authorable through a derived clone of a root-reachable schema; … was LIVE` (still refused)

   This confirms the docblock's claim with the real gate.

## Item 1 (ruled, already on `main`)

Item 1 was ruled by the maintainer on PR #29573 (comment 6593804783, 「显式 {} 就清掉,带前提」), and #29573 built it and is merged. The HTTP-door pin is on `main`: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/connector-meta-door-url-and-nested-keys.dogfood.test.ts`, test "`retryConfig: {}` replaces the stored one whole: the next read of the stored row no longer has the undeclared key", in the CARRY-FORWARD describe. It is a `PUT /meta/connector/:name` of the served form with `retryConfig: {}` over a seeded row holding `retryConfig.secret`. It asserts a `withheld-key-dropped` advisory at `connectors[0].retryConfig.secret`, the stored row's `retryConfig` equal to `{}`, and a control that a withheld position outside `retryConfig` is still carried forward. The served-object variant is in `connector-meta-door-undeclared-keys-withheld.dogfood.test.ts`. This PR adds no dogfood pin.

## Verification

All under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` on head `d1cdcbe1`, shared box:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: exit 0 (93 s).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: exit 0, 23961 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: exit 0, 89 files, 1522 tests (the deleted-baseline file runs here: 15/15, 186 s alone).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:test-typecheck` and `check:scripts-typecheck`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 58 families, each run and recorded. `--ran` exits 0 with 56 run, 2 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure`, both exit 3 because they need every package's `dist` and only spec was built. CI's Build Core runs them, and a test file under `packages/spec/scripts/` moves no dist. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone; after `git fetch origin 621a4876` it exited 0.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Changeset: none, label `skip-changeset`.** AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist 3) reserves the label for "a diff that publishes nothing from any released package". `packages/spec/package.json` `files` does not include `scripts/`, so this test file publishes nothing.
- `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`: no accept set and no authorable surface moves (the diff is one test file).
